Neha Shah, you have one course with attendance below the 75% minimum requirement [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2]:

* **CS301 - Database Management Systems**: 66.9% attendance [SQL]

**Can the shortfall be condoned?**
Yes. Since your attendance is 66.9%, which falls in the range of **at least 65% but below 75%**, the shortfall may be condoned on medical or other documented grounds [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3]. 

To receive condonation, you must meet the following conditions:
1. Submit a condonation application with supporting documents (e.g. a medical certificate) to the Head of Department [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
2. Pay a **condonation fee of ₹500 per course** [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
3. Request the condonation before the last teaching day of the term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3].
4. Note that a student may receive condonation in at most two courses per term [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §3]. 

If attendance falls below 65%, or a condonation request is rejected, you will be detained in the course [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4].
